tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Commissioner shall consult and cooperate with the heads of all appropriate Federal agencies or departments administering programs or services that are substantially related to the purposes of this chapter.

tree.heading: Interagency agreements
tree.text: To the extent practicable, the Commissioner shall facilitate cooperation through the entering into of interagency agreements.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective Oct. 1, 1990, see section 1001(a) of Pub. L. 101–501, set out as an Effective Date of 1990 Amendment note under section 8621 of this title.
